data.one_liner: A Dart port of the Liquid and Django HTML template engine.
data.what_it_does: Parses and renders HTML templates using context variables, loops, filters, and standard template tags. Supports features like whitespace control, booleans, and asynchronous rendering.
use_when: You need to generate HTML or text content dynamically from templates in Dart.
You want to use Liquid or Django template syntax within a Dart application.
avoid_when: You are building standard Flutter widget UIs where standard Flutter widget composition is preferred.
You need a complex state management or navigation system.
strengths: Familiar Liquid and Django template syntax.
Supports async rendering and web platform.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic examples.
Niche use case for most standard mobile app development.
